content.title: Build Apps 10x Faster with AI Vibe Coding
content.description: Stop writing boilerplate code and start describing what you want to build. AI Vibe Coding with Cursor IDE lets you create complete iOS, Android, and web applications using natural language. Whether you're a seasoned developer or complete beginner, our AI-powered approach transforms your ideas into production-ready code in days, not months.

content.title: Native iOS AI Apps with Swift & SwiftUI
content.description: Build beautiful, intelligent iOS applications that leverage Apple's latest AI capabilities. From ChatGPT-powered assistants to computer vision apps using Core ML and Vision framework, we help you create native Swift apps that delight users and dominate the App Store.

content.title: Powerful Android AI Apps with Kotlin
content.description: Create stunning Android applications with embedded AI capabilities using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Integrate TensorFlow Lite for on-device ML, ML Kit for vision and language AI, and OpenAI APIs for conversational intelligence—all optimized for the Play Store.

content.title: Add ChatGPT to Your Mobile Apps
content.description: Transform your app with conversational AI. We integrate OpenAI's GPT-4, Anthropic's Claude, and Google's Gemini into your iOS and Android apps. Build intelligent chatbots, AI assistants, content generators, and natural language interfaces that engage users and solve real problems.

content.title: Apps That See and Understand
content.description: Build mobile apps with powerful computer vision capabilities. From real-time object detection and image classification to OCR, barcode scanning, and AR experiences—we implement vision AI that works on-device for instant, private, and reliable results.

content.title: Voice-Enabled AI Applications
content.description: Create apps that listen, understand, and speak. We integrate Whisper for accurate speech recognition, ElevenLabs for natural voice synthesis, and native speech frameworks for voice commands. Build accessible, hands-free experiences that users love.

content.title: Smart Apps with RAG Technology
content.description: Build apps that can search and reason over your documents, databases, and knowledge bases. We implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that provide accurate, contextual AI responses with source citations—perfect for enterprise knowledge apps.

content.title: Launch Your AI App MVP in Weeks
content.description: Validate your app idea fast with our AI-powered rapid prototyping. Using Vibe Coding techniques, we build functional MVPs in 2-4 weeks that let you test with real users, attract investors, and iterate quickly—all at a fraction of traditional development cost.

content.title: One Codebase, Both Platforms
content.description: Launch on iOS and Android simultaneously with Flutter or React Native. We build cross-platform AI apps that maintain native performance and feel while sharing business logic. Perfect for startups that want to reach all users without doubling development costs.

content.title: Learn AI Vibe Coding
content.description: Transform your development skills with our AI coding workshops. Learn to use Cursor IDE, master prompt engineering, and build AI-integrated apps. Whether you're upskilling your team or learning solo, we'll make you a 10x developer with AI-powered tools.

content.title: From Code to App Store
content.description: We don't just build your app—we help you launch it successfully. Our team handles App Store and Play Store submission, optimization, and compliance. With 500+ apps launched, we know what it takes to get approved and rank well.

content.title: Enterprise-Grade AI Solutions
content.description: For larger organizations, we provide custom AI app development with enterprise security, compliance, and scale. From private LLM deployment to custom model training, we build AI solutions that meet the strictest requirements while delivering transformative results.
